question: The standing undelivered pile addressed to the tester is drained ONCE by a scratchpad script (the bus store is instance-space, not a record of truth); the count drained goes on the verdict artifact. After the build the next pile is the tester's job — is that the decision?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answered_by: Akien, migrated by caller class cc
by: Akien 2026-09-16 verbatim: 'they can be thrown away but in future that's tester's job not ours. so it has to be able to do that'; measured 2026-09-16 by BusDevice().undelivered(limit=10000): 628 undelivered envelopes — 619 from codemother, 8 from tester, 1 from press_office (2026-09-15 it read 677: 670 codemother->tester 'sealed reply', 603 of them about /tmp fixture proofs, 13 carrying a refused[] the tester never saw). cairn/tools/base/shim.py:645 posts every verb handler's dict back to envelope['sender'] as a personal '<verb> reply'; the tester is a bus CLIENT (reach/post/flush/exit) whose TesterShim (cairn/devices/tester/shim.py:12) is never wired in its own process, so every reply to it flushes to the store undelivered forever. Default receive() (cairn/tools/base/device.py:244) records delivered mail to ~/.cairn/devices/<dev>/0/tools/data_recorder/inbound/records.jsonl (press_office 116, tester 585, codemother 263, cairn 158 on 2026-09-15) and nothing reads or clears them; all stop 2026-09-13 18:15. press_office is a FOLDER, not a device: measured 2026-09-16 — no cairn/devices/press_office in class-space; ~/.cairn/folders/press_office/instanceizer.json (DataRecorder, first instanceizer tenant, provisioned 2026-09-03 per cairn/tools/instanceizer/intention+why.json) and the bus already activates it from the email: bus.py:208 _try_folder_delivery writes every envelope addressed to a folder into its recorder — ~/.cairn/folders/press_office/data/records.jsonl holds 167 records. The older device-shaped recorder at ~/.cairn/devices/press_office/0/tools/data_recorder/inbound/records.jsonl (117) is the stale path. One press_office->press_office personal envelope (WATCHME kind, 2026-09-15T18:43:59) stands undelivered — the one case the folder delivery did not take.
